pages.text: The Advanced and Elite Drone Frames are made of $(l)Carbon Fiber$(), as real racing drones are: light and stiff.

It takes a $(l)Cyber Frame$() on its left as you face it: right-click it alone and a drone shows where. Once complete, it opens into one long oven; it doesn't work until then, and breaking the frame folds it back.

The $(l)Pyrolysis Oven$() splits $(l)Methane$() into carbon and hydrogen (CH4 -> C + 2H2) and draws the carbon onto $(l)String$(): $(l)250 mB of Methane + 1 String -> 1 Carbon Fiber$(), in 4 seconds at $(l)120 FE/t$(). The oven takes Speed, Efficiency and Battery $(l:drone_systems/addons)addons$(/l) on the tab beside its GUI. Pipe the methane in from a $(l:generators/methane_extractor)Methane$(/l)

$(l:generators/methane_extractor)Extractor$(/l) or a gas tank, on its front, back or free side: its top is full. While it works a shuttle runs along the glowing slit, once per fiber, drawing the fiber behind it; if the shuttle stops, so has the machine.
So the gas tier is more than power: its methane is the raw material of every advanced frame.
